to.description: the recipients: each one plain email address, name@example.com — no display name

cc.description: the recipients it is copied to, the same way; there is no bcc: every recipient is shown

subject.description: the subject, one line; a reply keeps the subject of the message it answers, "Re: " or not

body.description: the text, plain, at most 64 KiB

in_reply_to.description: to reply: the id of the message this answers, as gmail.search gives it; the mail joins that message's thread
